tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Tenderer should preferably have been incorporated in Karnataka. If incorporated elsewhere, should have necessary permission/license to operate in Karnataka. The Tenderer Company shall be registered under the companies Act, 1956. Tenderer operational in Karnataka is preferred. The bidder should have office in Bangalore.
Tenderer shall not be under a declaration of corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka.
Prior experience of services to Government, PSUs will be an added advantage

The bidder shall mandatorily upload a Presentation on Work Methodology, deployment strategy, statutory compliance mechanism, and execution plan as part of the Technical Qualification documents in the KPPP portal, and the same may be considered during technical evaluation
